instructions: Fresh review of each primary candidate: read dialogue first, then exact cards. Assess all six unchanged criteria and all coach-2.0 gates with turn-specific evidence. For pairs, show whether the Stance changes HOW A pursues the Drive in one interaction. Do not invent missing backstory or assume prior approval. Use the alternate only to assess meaningful differentiation. Report actual reservations. No writer scores or improvement claims are supplied.
productionStandard:
PRODUCTION STANDARD coach-2.0. Historical coach-1.0 acceptance is not coach-2.0 acceptance. Read the dialogue first and record what the spoken words establish before interpreting the card. Exact cards are already in this invocation: label internal-dialogue-first, never blind or human review. Do not invent a charitable backstory; harmless unspecified names/history are not defects. Fill coach2 for ORIGINAL dialogue in writer output and CANDIDATE dialogue in reviewer output. Copy the supplied dialogue hash for the text being assessed. Give concise actual turn evidence, not generic claims.
G1: legible immediate situation, wants/stakes; separate stated, ordinary inferred, and missing essentials. Identify first material defect or explicitly none.
G2: coherent facts, ownership, timing, language, knowledge; recognizable misunderstanding/revelation is allowed, unstated intervening events are not.
G3: assess all A1-B2, B2-A3, A3-B4, B4-A5 links. Vocabulary repetition alone is insufficient. Purposeful avoidance must read as behavior.
G4: B is a plausible participant with an intelligible practical/emotional position, not a contrived punchline cue. B can help, concede or solve.
G5: exact card changes A's choices. For pairs Stance changes HOW A pursues Drive and B responds to the merged behavior; neither card may be decorative.
G6: ending develops the same behavior using B4. Investigate if A5 would work after unrelated B4; more obstacles are not required for heightening.
format: five spoken ABABA turns, existing word/schema limit, no narration/coaching/truncation.
Every mandatory gate and transition is PASS, FAIL or UNCLEAR with evidence; UNCLEAR cannot be accepted. All gates pass AND total >=85 AND fidelity/response >=4 AND others >=3; preserve the six weights 30/20/15/15/10/10. A 5 is not merely presence. Totals are derived in code. Retain good originals; no rewrite quota. Review both alternatives for different tactics, relationships or pressure. Scene outline identifies roles, task, A want, B want, stakes, exact-card tactic and B's contribution; it is private planning evidence, not a substitute for missing spoken facts. Humour must come from sincere priorities and responsive choices, not stock hierarchy or unrelated slogans. Record actual weaknesses and reservations. Writer corrections target only rejected/materially changed scenes; preserve all accepted records and prior original assessments exactly. No coach-1.0 failure or exhausted allowance is erased by this separately versioned cycle.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Terms and Conditions
cards.instruction: Treat every offer, favor, feeling, and apology as a negotiation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your ladder application is approved at two lifts to the station.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I have a five-minute rate? That's all I need.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: One lift is authorized. You may add a compliment about my roses for the missing journey.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I just pay cash?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Cash is approved at five pounds. I'll permit a two-pound reduction if you say we're still friends while handing it over.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your apology for missing my birthday may be accepted in exchange for first choice of Christmas dates.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can Mum have Christmas Day? She's expecting me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Mum's claim is approved. I will permit Boxing Day in return for telling her I'm no longer hurt.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Could you actually stop being hurt instead of just telling her?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Genuine forgiveness is authorized for a stay through New Year. You may deduct one day if you offer to wash up without being asked.

cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Yes, but My Way
cards.instruction: Agree with others, then reinterpret the agreement entirely in your favor.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, your request for sofa-moving assistance is approved. I'll take the cushions.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: They're sewn on. Can we lift together?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Together is approved. You lift; I'll give the countdown.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I mean two people underneath it.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. Two lifters are authorized. You may hire the second on your phone; I'll ensure you both receive the same countdown.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Yes, I've approved looking after your dog during the kitchen repairs. Bring him after his walk.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can he stay overnight too?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Overnight is approved. You may use my guest room so you can handle his breakfast while I sleep.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll stay, but can you do the six o'clock walk?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed. I authorize a six o'clock walk. I'll put the lead by the door and set your alarm; you may leave the planning entirely to me.

cards.title: The Pattern
cards.instruction: Treat every minor detail as evidence of a much larger problem.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've authorized an inquiry into the two missing office biscuits. This has the shape of an organized operation.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I ate them. Can we close the inquiry?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Closure is denied. A confession that quick suggests training. You may explain who prepared you.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Nobody. I was hungry. Can I go to lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Lunch is approved under my observation. If they're recruiting through hunger, I need to see who supplies your sandwich.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: My meeting email reached nobody. I've authorized a review of this office's entire communication system.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's still in your drafts. Can I just send it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Sending is approved. One lapse of my memory and an entire meeting vanishes. We have no second line of command.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll cover your inbox while you have lunch. Will that help?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your temporary command is approved. We need a succession plan before I take a sandwich; apparently my lunch is now an institutional vacancy.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may assist with my shelf for a moment. Just hold this bracket against the holes.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Can I let go soon? I'm dressed for work.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Release is approved after one turn of that top screw. Could you just do that?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Excellent. You're authorized to tighten those, just to check, then slide the shelf on. I'll get your coat; you needn't do another thing.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may hold my wedding bouquet a moment. Just pinch the stems while I sort this sliding ribbon.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I've got them. Can we use wire underneath?

beats.speaker: A

beats.text: Done. The end will snag the dress.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You may tuck it in, then just wind the ribbon over it. One little bow is authorized. I'll supervise the scissors.

cards.title: One Last Thing
cards.instruction: Keep someone present by discovering one more small task, question, or favor whenever departure seems near.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Your inspection of my new flat is almost approved. Just check that window latch before you go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's shut. Can I leave now?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Departure is pending. Why is the curtain moving?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: The fan's on. That's all.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Explanation approved. You may show me which switch turns it off; there are several. Then I'll be ready to release you.

beats.text: I've approved your taxi plan. You may dry this last cup before it arrives.

beats.speaker: B
